ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Dressing Room uses your camera to photograph your clothes for your closet.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Dressing Room uses the photos you pick to add your clothes to your closet.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Dressing Room uses your location once to find your city, so outfit suggestions can match the weather.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Dressing Room uses the microphone only while you tap to dictate a city or an occasion.
ios.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Dressing Room turns what you dictate into text to fill in a city or pick an occasion.
